Pandav Sena Chief Sanjay Singh Arrested in Delhi

Sanjay Singh, the leader of the Pandav Sena group, was arrested by the Special Task Force (STF) while traveling back to Delhi. His wife had expressed concerns about his safety before his arrest. The incident highlights the ongoing law enforcement efforts against organized crime groups.
